newsletter.markdown:
1. **Discovery & Translational Science**

- **Synthetic biology platform enables oral delivery of dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonist** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.22.26365662)
  - Engineered *Saccharomyces cerevisiae* using CRISPR/Cas12a multi-copy integration yielded 4.05 mg/g dry biomass of pro-DALAP, a fusion precursor of a dual GLP-1/GIP agonist containing an albumin-binding domain and furin cleavage sites.
  - In vitro characterization confirmed GM1 ganglioside binding, furin cleavage, and functional activation of both GLP-1 and GIP receptors.
  - Preclinical IV toxicity testing in rats demonstrated no adverse findings up to 300 µg/kg/day for 7 days.

- **Systemic clonal hematopoiesis artifact distorts solid-tumor genomic databases** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.10.26365222)
  - Analysis of 1.28 million coding calls across 483 studies revealed patient-keyed database merging imports blood normal clonal hematopoiesis (CH) variants into solid tumor matrices.
  - Blood-derived calls accounted for 52.8% of *DNMT3A*, 21.3% of *TET2*, and 19.7% of *CHEK2* mutations assigned to solid tumors without corresponding tumor calls.
  - Applying pre-aggregation filtering corrected pan-cancer *DNMT3A* prevalence estimates by 45% and resolved survival estimation distortions.

- **Autopsy-confirmed GWAS identifies genetic drivers and neocortical spread of Lewy body pathology** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.21.26366146)
  - Meta-analysis of 2,661 autopsy-confirmed Lewy body disease cases identified 5 genome-wide significant loci: *APOE4* (OR = 2.27), *GBA1* E326K (OR = 2.57), *SNCA* (OR = 1.35), *TMEM175* p.M393T (OR = 1.30), and *HLA* class II (OR = 0.69).
  - Comparing neocortical (n = 1,362) vs. brainstem/limbic (n = 947) pathology demonstrated distinct lead variant associations driving cortical spread after controlling for co-occurring Alzheimer's pathology.

- **White-matter routing digital biomarker detects Alzheimer's disease progression up to 4 years prior to conversion** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.21.26366165)
  - Diffusion MRI-derived Route Concordance Index (RCI) across 316 periventricular white-matter pathways declined monotonically across five preclinical AD stages (AUC = 0.817 vs. stable controls).
  - Combining RCI and graph Laplacian conductance with clinical/imaging covariates predicted conversion to MCI/AD up to 4 years prior to diagnosis (AUC = 0.831; AUC = 0.918 within 1 year).
  - Performance was externally validated in the ADNI cohort (n = 609, AUC = 0.797) and correlated with CSF amyloid-β₄₂ levels.

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II**

- **[Biotech]** **Agenus reports 72% complete response with botensilimab/balstilimab in neoadjuvant colon cancer** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2114318694428143989)
  - Phase 2 NEOASIS study evaluated the Fc-enhanced anti-CTLA-4 botensilimab (BOT) plus anti-PD-1 balstilimab (BAL) in locally advanced dMMR colon cancer.
  - After 6 weeks of neoadjuvant therapy, 72% of patients achieved a pathologic complete response with no remaining viable tumor at surgical resection.

- **[Biotech]** **Visugromab plus nivolumab demonstrates neoadjuvant efficacy in muscle-invasive bladder cancer** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04740-9)
  - Phase 2a GDFATHER-NEO trial evaluated the GDF-15-neutralizing antibody visugromab combined with nivolumab in checkpoint inhibitor-naive muscle-invasive bladder cancer.
  - The combination produced encouraging pathologic complete response and radiographic response rates without adding novel safety signals.

- **[Biotech]** **Genmab reports updated Phase 2 petosemtamab data in metastatic colorectal cancer** [X / BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2114319037974901080)
  - Updated Phase 2 follow-up presented at ESMO 2026 demonstrated meaningful objective response rates with EGFR/LGR5 bispecific antibody petosemtamab in patients with mCRC.

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III**

- **[Big Pharma]** **Bristol Myers Squibb highlights 5-year survival gains with relatlimab plus nivolumab in advanced melanoma** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04756-1)
  - 5-year follow-up from the Phase 3 RELATIVITY-047 trial demonstrated sustained improvements in PFS, OS, and melanoma-specific survival with relatlimab (anti-LAG-3) plus nivolumab vs. nivolumab monotherapy in untreated metastatic or unresectable melanoma.
  - Biomarker analyses confirmed high baseline levels of LAG-3⁺ CD8⁺ T cells strongly correlated with clinical response and overall survival benefits in the dual-checkpoint arm.

- **[Biotech]** **Summit Therapeutics presents Phase 3 Harmoni-GI1 results for ivonescimab in cholangiocarcinoma** [X / Jacob Plieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2114275124878946686)
  - Phase 3 Harmoni-GI1 study in first-line cholangiocarcinoma showed PD-1/VEGF bispecific ivonescimab + chemotherapy achieved median OS of 14.9 months vs. 12.1 months for durvalumab + chemotherapy (HR = 0.75, p = 0.0031).
  - Contextual comparison noted Merck's Keynote-966 China extension cohort reported 14.1 months median OS for pembrolizumab + chemotherapy in a 158-patient subset.

- **[Big Pharma]** **AstraZeneca Claudin18.2 ADC matches competitors in Phase 3 gastric cancer trial** [X / Jacob Plieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2114277572855095807)
  - Phase 3 Clarity-Gastric01 study evaluated AstraZeneca's Claudin18.2 ADC in a Western gastric cancer population, matching overall survival outcomes seen with Innovent/Takeda's arcotatug tavatecan in G-Hope-001.
  - Subgroup analysis demonstrated an overall survival HR of 0.63 in patients with 25% to 75% Claudin18.2 expression levels.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Pfizer's integrin β6 ADC sigvotatug vedotin fails Phase 3 lung cancer study** [X / Jacob Plieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2114272822507811102)
  - Phase 3 Sigvie-002 trial evaluating sigvotatug vedotin vs. docetaxel in 2L+ non-small cell lung cancer failed to meet its primary overall survival endpoint.
  - Docetaxel outperformed sigvotatug vedotin in third-line or later patients; two additional Phase 3 studies of the ADC remain ongoing.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Eli Lilly reports overall survival from Phase 3 postMONARCH trial of abemaciclib** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42926108/)
  - Final overall survival analysis from the Phase 3 postMONARCH study evaluated abemaciclib plus fulvestrant vs. placebo plus fulvestrant in HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer after progression on a prior CDK4/6 inhibitor plus endocrine therapy.

- **[Big Pharma]** **Merck reports final KEYNOTE-B49 results for pembrolizumab in HR+/HER2- breast cancer** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42926111/)
  - Final analysis of the Phase 3 KEYNOTE-B49 study evaluated pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy vs. placebo plus chemotherapy in PD-L1-positive, HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer.

- **Phase 3 PRABITAS trial evaluates 14-day vs 28-day Lonsurf schedule in metastatic colorectal cancer** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42925880/)
  - Multicenter, open-label Phase 3 non-inferiority trial in Japan compared a 14-day vs. standard 28-day schedule of trifluridine-tipiracil plus bevacizumab in refractory metastatic colorectal cancer.

4. **Regulatory & Approvals**

- **[Big Pharma]** **FDA converts Keytruda Qlex to traditional approval; updates oncology accelerated approvals** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/other-cancer-accelerated-approvals)
  - FDA converted pembrolizumab and berahyaluronidase alfa-pmph (Keytruda Qlex) to traditional approval on October 16, 2026 for TMB-high (≥10 mut/Mb) solid tumors.
  - Updated database tracks active oncology accelerated approvals, including mosunetuzumab-axgb (Lunsumio Velo) for relapsed/refractory follicular lymphoma and zanubrutinib (Brukinsa) for mantle cell lymphoma.

- **US FDA oncology approval trends (2014–2025) show heavy reliance on surrogate endpoints** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.21.26366185)
  - Analysis of 143 immunotherapy and 211 non-immunotherapy FDA cancer approvals (2014–2025) revealed median development time to approval converged to ~2,079 and 2,357 days in 2024/2025.
  - Surrogate endpoints have predominantly replaced overall survival (OS); for non-immunotherapies, only a median of 60% of surrogate progression-free survival benefit translated into OS gains, compared to 99% for immunotherapies.

5. **Business & Strategy**

- **[Big Pharma]** **Merck and Moderna present ESMO strategy for mRNA personalized cancer vaccine expansion** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/25/mrna-cancer-vaccine-merck-moderna-esmo-intismeran-next-applications/?utm_campaign=rss)
  - Merck and Moderna detailed plans at ESMO 2026 to expand clinical development of personalized mRNA neoantigen therapy (intismeran / mRNA-4157) into multiple tumor types beyond resected melanoma.
  - Clinical strategy focuses on combination regimens with Keytruda across high-risk adjuvant and metastatic solid tumor settings.

6. **Public Health & Policy**

- **Large-scale pharmacovigilance and Mendelian randomization re-evaluate semaglutide NAION risk** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.06.26362369)
  - Analysis of 12.3 million FAERS and 1.05 million JADER reports showed semaglutide carried 879 NAION reports with an unadjusted reporting odds ratio of 120.8, driven by a 48.6-fold surge in reporting following initial regulatory and media exposure.
  - Mendelian randomization using 6 *GLP1R* cis-eQTL variants instrumenting ischemic optic neuropathy showed no causal genetic risk, bounding the true relative risk far lower than reporting-bias signals suggest.

- **Occupational radiation exposure linked to subtype-specific cerebrovascular mortality** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.21.26366178)
  - Follow-up of 110,368 U.S. radiologic technologists (1983–2021; 1,199 CeVD deaths) evaluated cumulative occupational low-to-moderate dose radiation exposure (<1 Gy).
  - Cumulative thyroid-absorbed dose was significantly associated with overall CeVD mortality (excess hazard ratio per 100 mGy = 0.07, p = 0.01) and ischemic stroke mortality (excess hazard ratio per 100 mGy = 0.10, p = 0.01), with no significant association found for hemorrhagic stroke.

youtube.markdown:
- Biology & Health
    - [‘Scientists discovered a Supplement that Rejuvenates Mitochondria!’](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Km3lllxQi1s) -- Physionic
        - Urolithin A acts as a mitophagy inducer that clears out old and damaged mitochondria to promote mitochondrial rejuvenation.
        - Randomized clinical trials show direct supplementation with Urolithin A improves muscle strength, exercise performance, and cardiorespiratory fitness (VO2 metrics).
        - Urolithin A supplementation helps mitigate age-related immune decline and reduces cartilage degeneration associated with osteoarthritis.
        - Direct supplementation overcomes natural limitations related to dietary intake and gut microbiome variability to ensure consistent target compound levels across populations.
- Pure Science
    - [Why do hot objects glow?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/YBKuWCA5pug) -- minutephysics
        - Blackbody radiation causes all physical objects to emit light with a spectrum determined by their thermal temperature.
        - Human bodies emit thermal radiation primarily in the infrared wavelength spectrum because their temperature is too low to produce visible light.
        - High-temperature objects such as lava, hot iron, or soot emit electromagnetic radiation shifted into the visible light spectrum, producing a red-orange glow.
    - [25 - Fracture #mathctober](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/1wGzBubdMtQ) -- El Jj
        - The video uses fractions to construct a fractal in response to the prompt word "fracture."
        - The creator speaks with a nasal tone toward the end of the video.
        - The creator explains that the nasal tone in their voice is caused by illness.
- Economics
    - [Who Really Pays for AI Data Centers?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NyOeLB0WVNE) -- Patrick Boyle
        - Public opposition to AI data centers in the U.S. stands at three to one—ranking lower than coal and nuclear facilities—leading local communities to pass moratoriums over water, noise, and power concerns.
        - Companies have attempted to bypass utility constraints to meet infrastructure demands, such as xAI using a fleet of unpermitted gas turbines to power its Memphis supercomputer.
        - Financial exposure from data center funding spans from distressed credit default swaps (e.g., CoreWeave) to investment-grade bonds purchased by pension funds.
        - The structure of the current AI infrastructure financing boom presents systemic risk patterns analogous to historical speculative market events, such as the railroad bubble of 1873.
